title: FusionEval: Benchmarking Model Fusion for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model fusion aims to integrate the capabilities of multi-expert models into a single model. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage of reasoning with long chains of thought and tool use, while strong average performance can mask substantial losses in individual expert capabilities. We introduce FusionEval, a benchmark that provides controlled expert pools, integrates fusion methods with and without additional training, and offers a unified evaluation suite. The pools contain domain experts independently trained from Qwen3 and Llama base models across math, code, science, instruction following, and tool use. The suite evaluates capability retention and computational cost on eight public benchmarks under comparable data access rules, reporting normalized average and worst performance, runtime, and peak GPU memory usage. translated_title: FusionEval：面向大语言模型模型融合的基准测试
translated_abstract: 模型融合旨在将多个专家模型的能力整合到单一模型中。现有评估对长思维链推理和工具使用的覆盖有限，而良好的平均性能可能掩盖单个专家能力的大幅损失。我们提出了FusionEval，这是一个提供受控专家池、整合有无额外训练的融合方法、并提供统一评估套件的基准。专家池包含从Qwen3和Llama基础模型独立训练的领域专家，涵盖数学、代码、科学、指令遵循和工具使用五个领域。该评估套件在可比较的数据访问规则下，在八个公开基准上评估能力保留与计算成本，报告归一化的平均性能与最差性能、运行时间以及峰值GPU内存占用。大量实验表明，无需训练的方法能够保留推理性能，但会显著降低工具使用……
tldr: 提出了FusionEval基准，通过受控专家池和统一评估套件系统评估大语言模型的模型融合方法，揭示无需训练的融合方法虽能保留推理性能，但会显著损害工具使用能力。
